rows.reasoning: Romero's own words ('We are reaffirming our commitment in support of abortion rights and the right to choose') show she is on the pro-access side, but none states a time limit or the stage after which only the mother's health would justify abortion. Nothing separates the rungs on that side, so the row is only a direction.
